description: Parameter and local assignment shadowing suppress precise calls but not broad imports.

expected_affected.tests/test_price.py::test_price: Calls the actual changed core.price function.

expected_unaffected.tests/test_control.py::test_control: Calls only unchanged control.healthy in an independent subsystem.
expected_unaffected.tests/test_shadow.py::test_parameter: Supplies a separate lambda; the parameter shadows the imported price.
expected_unaffected.tests/test_shadow.py::test_local: Calls a local lambda assigned to price; it never calls core.price.

false_positives.tests/test_shadow.py::test_parameter: worker imports core, retaining a conservative path despite parameter shadowing.
false_positives.tests/test_shadow.py::test_local: worker imports core, retaining a conservative path despite assignment shadowing.

limitations: Precise call resolution respects function parameter/local-store shadowing, but module fallback can still overselect both tests.
